{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = df.dtypes

# Check unique values in key columns
unique_sex = df['sex'].unique()
unique_arm = df['arm'].unique()
unique_site = df['site'].unique()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker columns
sentinel_values = {'biomarker_baseline': [-999.0], 'biomarker_final': [-999.0]}

# Print summary
print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)
print("\nData types:\n", dtypes)
print("\nUnique values - sex:", unique_sex)
print("\nUnique values - arm:", unique_arm)
print("\nUnique values - site:", unique_site)
print("\nSentinel values check:")
for col, sentinels in sentinel_values.items():
    found = df[col].isin(sentinels).sum()
    print(f"  {col}: {found} occurrences")"}
